title: Device contexts and the merged feed: every online device, one inbox
summary: Replace the singleton session/scope with a per-device context registry (core/deviceContexts.js) and open a session to every online device, joining late devices on their device_key push; poll each device's board.list and project.list and deliver one merged feed whose rows carry deviceId and projectKey; tag change events and cache sync by device; make offline per device with the banner only when no device is live. The inbox and projects rail render the merge with device-qualified keys; rows from other devices work their inbox verbs against their own device but stay unroutable until routes carry a device. The picker is untouched; App.session/App.call remain as aliases of the home device.

title: Composite identity and device-bearing routes: open any row from any device
summary:
Routes become #/device//project/

/... with device-less and legacy URLs resolving across every device's feed (collisions prefer the home device, then the first online device); every route producer carries deviceId and every view, sheet, rail and console takes its call, cache scope and chat repository from the route's device context; terminals follow the route's device; the stage 1 read-only rule is deleted. Ratcheted router functions do not grow; the device prefix is peeled in a helper.

title: Retire the switcher: the picker filters, the app has no current device
summary: The device picker becomes a filter (All devices by default) plus the settings cog; a Creation device select on the account Settings page is the one owner of where new projects and captures go; the model catalog and the remaining bridge-scoped settings panels move onto the device context and the per-device settings page; App.session/App.call/App.cacheScope/App.chatRepository/App.offline, switchDevice and resetFeedScope are deleted and a source-scan test keeps them out; README, UX Redesign Decisions and HANDOFF record the new scope and the follow-ons.
